It behaves like dense liquid graphite, soft gel, or smooth high-viscosity fluid. Its tonal transitions are continuous and seamless. Cover the entire object with a continuous frosted translucent outer skin. The skin is a thick cold-white industrial resin combining frosted acrylic and milky polycarbonate characteristics. It directly follows and wraps the exact geometry of {SUBJECT}. The skin is part of the object itself.

IOR: 1.46  
Roughness: 0.60  
Specular: 0.22  
Transmission: 0.34  
SSS: 0.19

copy_prompt:
Create a production-grade {CHANNEL} image in {RATIO} using the visual language of a recovered post-human specimen archive.

SUBJECT:
Use {SUBJECT} as the central specimen. Preserve enough anatomy to identify the human origin. Reconstruct the body as a hybrid of translucent biological membrane, soft resin-like tissue, clear glass-like layers, iridescent interference film, filament mesh, exposed cables, black chrome mechanical joints, micro-circuitry and suspended fragments.

FORM:
The subject should feel incomplete, fractured and partially reconstructed. Use missing facial regions, open cavities, dissolved edges, irregular transparent shells, offset layers and asymmetry. Maintain elegance and anatomical plausibility. The visual tension should come from fragile biological tissue surrounding precise cold machinery.

MATERIAL:
Use wet translucent silicone, clear resin, soft bio-film, milky membrane, pearlescent refraction, fine mesh and black mechanical internals. Keep rainbow interference localized. Preserve real depth, thickness, refraction and subsurface scattering.

COMPOSITION:
Use a single dominant specimen occupying roughly 55%–82% of the frame. Allow intentional cropping at the top, sides or bottom. Keep generous empty background around the specimen. Prioritize head, profile, hand, spine, torso or isolated anatomical fragments.

BACKGROUND:
Use a smooth low-saturation {COLOR_VARIANT} seamless background. Keep it quiet and clinical, with only subtle haze, noise or scan texture.

LIGHTING:
Use large soft diffused studio lighting from the front-upper region. Keep shadows soft and contrast moderate. Let transparent materials carry bright specular edges, bloom and transmission. Avoid dramatic hard spotlighting.

IMAGE TREATMENT:
Add subtle chromatic aberration, optical refraction, soft bloom, ghosting and localized horizontal or vertical temporal smear. Preserve subject readability. Add slight archival grain and low-contrast haze.

GRAPHIC SYSTEM:
Overlay a sparse white archival interface. Use thin crosshair markers arranged in a loose 3×3 field. Add one small specimen code near the top. Place {TITLE} and {SUBTITLE} in the lower-left area. Use thin monospaced typography. Optional {DATA} may appear as one short annotation with a fine leader line and star-like marker.

TEXT:
Title: {TITLE}
Subtitle: {SUBTITLE}
Data: {DATA}
Product / project label: {PRODUCT_NAME}

NEGATIVE DIRECTION:
Avoid conventional armored robots, glossy sci-fi suits, neon cyberpunk streets, dense HUD panels, game-character styling, superhero anatomy, symmetric perfect faces, hard plastic mannequin skin, excessive rainbow color and decorative typography.

OUTPUT:
The final image should feel like a future biological archive: a human-derived lifeform recovered from a fractured timeline, rendered with clinical restraint, fragile materiality and cold technological precision.

壳体透明度采用低到中低可视透明。内部主体整体应“可感知，但难看清”。壳体边缘与圆角更亮、更透，中央区域更雾化、更柔和。内部清晰度由与壳体前表面的实际距离驱动：只有少量真正高压贴壁的区域出现清晰毛丝、短绒或轮廓；大部分内部区域经过磨砂扩散后保持柔和模糊。以视觉结果优先，避免整体过清或整体统一糊化。

内部填充一个 `{SUBJECT}`，当前确认材质为高密度超细长毛绒。内芯必须略大于壳体内部有效容积，像被充气后继续膨胀的软体，再受到外壳向内约束。内芯不是“刚好放进去”，而是持续顶住四边与四角，内部自由空间接近 0。受压后形成明显但克制的鼓包、回压、褶皱、堆毛、局部毛流分岔、软体错位与前后层次。顶部毛发蓬松外扩后因重量弯曲，侧面毛流逐渐向下，底部长毛更明显下垂；边缘形成柔软不规则长绒剪影。

将 `{CONTENT}` 转化为立体灰色短绒 / 毛毡实体。当前示例为中文“印”。文字采用柔软填充厚度与圆润截面，约 30%–45% 嵌入长毛层；周围白色长毛因挤压向外翻开和分流，部分毛发轻微覆盖文字边缘。文字与毛绒抱枕属于同一软体物理系统，并共同受到外壳压力影响。文字清晰度同样遵循贴壳更清晰、深入内部更模糊。

右下保留小型 L1 表层压印角标，视觉权重低。使用大型柔光源从正面偏上方照明，环境光均匀，高光宽而柔；壳体圆角出现乳白亮边，主体底部保留极浅接触阴影。摄影机正视，轻微产品摄影透视压缩，主体居中，四周保留均匀负空间。

最终视觉必须同时读出：厚实圆润磨砂外壳、内部过量膨胀、壳体约束、局部贴壁清晰、大部深处模糊、毛绒受压形变、立体文字内嵌。
